notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
Dockside Extortionist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving all +1/+1 counters from Dockside Extortionist onto another permanent you control.
Repeat.
If opponents control six or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.
